kills.property: Only the owner can call sendMoney, so only an owner-initiated sendMoney can cause a state change like a balance decrease
kills.change_summary: Delete the `require(msg.sender==owner)` check so anyone can call onlyOwner-protected functions including withdrawAll.

kills.property: If sendMoney does not revert, the call must have succeeded and transferred exactly the requested amount.
kills.change_summary: Delete the require statement that checks the result of the low-level call, allowing a failed sendMoney call to silently succeed without reverting.
